description: Department RAG golden evaluation set — Recall@K / MRR@K baseline
_annotationGuide: 1. Run 'npm run rag:check' to list available notebook IDs.
2. For each notebook to evaluate, add a suite entry below (copy the template).
3. Write queries that real users would ask against that notebook.
4. For each query, run a search via the UI or API and review the returned chunks.
5. Record which results are truly relevant:
- 'relevantDocIds': document-level annotation (easier — just the document IDs)
If 'relevantChunkKeys' is present it takes precedence over 'relevantDocIds'.
6. Set 'skip: false' on the suite when it is ready to evaluate.
8. Run with reranker comparison: node scripts/rag-quality-test.mjs --compare-rerank

suites.description: Template — fill in a real notebook ID and annotate queries, then set skip: false
